author: makortel
body:
#### PR description:

It was noted in https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/51699#issuecomment-5293286407 that these edmProvDump tests fail if run in a developer area without `FWCore/Integration` checked out, because the `FileInPath` resolves differently compared to the reference files. This PR extends the tests with separate reference files for the "local" and "release" locations of the `FileInPath`.

AI assistance was used

Resolves https://github.com/cms-sw/framework-team/issues/2392

#### PR validation:

Unit tests succeed with `FWCore/Integration` not checked out.
title: Fix edmProvDump test for FileInPath local vs. release behavior
